Title: 3 Warning Signs of Prediabetes Most People Miss

Description:
1 in 3 American adults already has prediabetes, and most have no idea. Your body may already be flagging it - through skin changes, how long you sit, and how little you sleep.

Dark velvety skin patches (acanthosis nigricans), sitting 8+ hours without a break, and getting less than 6 hours of sleep are all linked to rising insulin resistance. Watch to find out why, and the simple fix for each one.
